label: PRIOR_4 among the actual CONCRETE_6 individuals at w is well-founded
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred, the restricted PRIOR_4 sibling of d85de8e1: there is no infinite descending chain of actual concreta at w each prior in being (PRIOR_4) to the one before. It constrains only chains among beings that are concrete and exist at w; it is weaker than well-foundedness of PRIOR_4 on the whole carrier. No current consumer on a root route takes it: the prima via chain from d85de8e1 (e229bb2c) needs PRIOR_1, because e078f07b makes every efficient cause, in any respect, prior to its effect, and an efficient cause in a respect is not in general PRIOR_4 to its effect (the stick can be without the hand).

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Two bridges at the same world w: (1) from no infinite PRIOR_4 descent among actual concreta to some actual concretum that is first in being (none other is PRIOR_4 to it), which needs a classical minimal element, a nonempty set of actual concreta, and that whatever is PRIOR_4 to an actual concretum is itself an actual concretum; (2) from that first in being to the claim that every first mover moved by none is first in being, i.e. identification of the first unmoved mover with the bearer supplied by (1).
connection_plan.blocker: Bridge (2) is the same-bearer obstacle (#1926 findings): well-foundedness gives some first in being, not that the first mover is it. No warrant for that identification is on file (docs/notes/one-dependence-order.md, 'Connection plan for 522506d1').
